@loveamourpropre Follow us on IG.

About our brand and products: Amour Propre® is a clean beauty and wellness brand dedicated to redefining self-care through science-based, superfood-infused personal hygiene solutions. We address sensitive skin concerns, organic feminine wellness, and holistic self-care from a melanated perspective.

Our mission is to bridge the gap in the clean beauty market by offering luxurious, aromatherapeutic, affordable, and highly effective products f or all. From moisturizing feminine oils to gentle skincare solutions for eczema, hyperpigmentation, and aging, each formulation is intentionally crafted. Amour Propre® is committed to small-batch production to ensure the highest quality in every product we create.

Our 100-product portfolio spans natural facial care, feminine hygiene solutions, men’s grooming, bath and body essentials, and candles and home décor. Our products have earned top-seller recognition on Amazon and have been honored for ethics by the Better Business Bureau.

Founded in Orange County, California in 2020 and inspired by the belief that clean beauty is for everyone, we invite our customers to indulge in self-care that nurtures all skin types, backgrounds, bodies, and souls. At Amour Propre®, self-love is a luxurious necessity.

Our long-term vision is to become a leading clean beauty and wellness brand that empowers individuals through education, inclusivity, and elevated self-care. We aim to expand into national retail and global markets while building community through digital content, strategic partnerships, sustainable manufacturing, and generational impact.

Amour Propre Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions


Effective Date: March 30, 2025


Thank you for your interest in becoming an affiliate for Amour Propre ("Company", "we", "us", or "our"). By signing up for and participating in our Affiliate Program, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following Terms and Conditions.


1. Eligibility


You must be at least 18 years of age and have the legal capacity to enter into binding agreements. We reserve the right to accept or reject any affiliate application at our sole discretion.


2. Affiliate Responsibilities


As an affiliate, you agree to:


Promote Amour Propre products in a positive, ethical, and lawful manner.


Only use marketing materials provided or approved by Amour Propre.


Not make any false claims, guarantees, or misleading representations.


Refrain from using paid advertising or spam tactics to promote your affiliate link.


3. Commissions


Affiliates earn between 10% and 25% commission on qualifying sales.


Commissions are paid bi-monthly via PayPal, based on sales tracked through your unique referral link.


You will not earn a commission on your own purchases.


All commissions are subject to a 14-day holding period to allow for returns and fraud reviews.


4. Affiliate Tracking


We use cookies to track referrals. Standard cookie duration is 30 days.


Sales made after this period or without tracking will not be credited.


5. Termination


We reserve the right to terminate your affiliate status at any time for:


Breach of these terms


Inactivity for more than 90 days


Any form of dishonesty, misrepresentation, or unethical behavior


6. Relationship


You are an independent contractor. Nothing in this agreement shall create a partnership, joint venture, agency, or employer-employee relationship.


7. Limitation of Liability


We are not responsible for indirect, special, or consequential damages arising in connection with this program.


8. Modifications


We may modify any of these terms at any time. Continued participation constitutes acceptance of the changes.


9. Contact Information


If you have questions or concerns, please contact us at:

Email: support@amourp.com

Website: www.amourp.com
